name: P1 a relative import may leave the tree of its own package
old: if(!inside(base,canon))fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","import fuera de la raiz del proyecto");

name: P2 the lock of the closure is not verified
old: (void)packageCommand("check",pkg,true,fs::path{});   // the lock of the whole closure must still match its bytes

name: P3 a dependency that is not declared is looked up anyway
P4 a path with .. components after the dependency name is accepted
old: for(const auto& part:sub)if(part==".."||part==".")fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","ruta de dependencia no puede contener . ni ..",i.loc);

name: P5 an absolute path after the dependency name is accepted
old: if(sub.is_absolute()||sub.has_root_name()||sub.extension()!=".omni")fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","ruta de dependencia debe ser relativa y .omni",i.loc);
new: if(sub.extension()!=".omni")fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","ruta de dependencia debe ser relativa y .omni",i.loc);

name: P6 a path that is not a .omni file is accepted
old: if(sub.is_absolute()||sub.has_root_name()||sub.extension()!=".omni")fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","ruta de dependencia debe ser relativa y .omni",i.loc);
new: if(sub.is_absolute()||sub.has_root_name())fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","ruta de dependencia debe ser relativa y .omni",i.loc);

name: P7 a file outside src/ of its package may import a dependency
old: if(!inside(pkg/"src",file))fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","el archivo que importa una dependencia debe estar bajo src/ de su package");

name: P8 a file under no package may import a dependency
old: if(pkg.empty())fail("E_IMPORT_PATH","import de dependencia fuera de todo package: @"+name);

name: P9 the dependency name may be empty
equivalent: A dependency name that is empty can never be declared: the manifest reader refuses an empty name (nameOk), so the lookup in lockedDependencySource fails with the same E_IMPORT_PATH ("dependencia no declarada") that the removed guard would have produced; the guard only gives the message a better text.

name: P10 the dependency source may be a symbolic link
equivalent: The lock check that runs just before (packageCommand check -> readPackage -> semanticSourceHash) refuses a symbolic link in the source tree of every package of the closure with E_PACKAGE_PATH, so by the time this line is reached the directory cannot be a link; the check is a second guard.
